ability.name: Step 1 - Register Subnets
ability.description: Registers subnets to prepare for multi-homing sweeps.

stages.command_template: $d='C:\\Windows\\Temp\\bas'; if(!(Test-Path $d)){ni -ItemType Directory -Force $d|out-null}; $(try { $cidrs_file = "$d\network_cidrs.txt"; if (Test-Path $cidrs_file) { $cidrs = Get-Content $cidrs_file; $primary = $cidrs[0]; Write-Output "PRIMARY_CIDR: $primary"; Write-Output "ALL_CIDRS: $($cidrs | ConvertTo-Json -Compress)" } else { throw "network_cidrs.txt not found" } } catch { Write-Output "ERROR: step1 failed - $_" }) | Tee-Object -FilePath $d\step1.txt

rationale: Extracts the dynamically determined network adapter configurations.
